name: obsidian-vim-mode-per-device
description: Turn Obsidian's Vim key bindings on or off per device type.

scripts.build: tsc --noEmit && bun build src/main.ts --outfile main.js --format cjs --target browser --minify --external obsidian --external electron --external '@codemirror/*' --external '@lezer/*'
scripts.dev: bun build src/main.ts --outfile main.js --format cjs --target browser --sourcemap=inline --watch --external obsidian --external electron --external '@codemirror/*' --external '@lezer/*'
